note: Passive registry. Fields are ids, files, titles and human-readable triggers only. The skeleton decides WHEN to read a section; nothing here does.

sections.title: Greenfield route
sections.trigger: the terrain has been classified Greenfield and you are mapping or re-checking the route

sections.title: Brownfield / oilfield route
sections.trigger: the terrain has been classified Brownfield or Oilfield and you are mapping or re-checking the route

sections.title: Minefield route
sections.trigger: the terrain has been classified Minefield and you are mapping or re-checking the route

sections.title: Ongoing evolution route and cadence
sections.trigger: the system is live and you are running /restack-journey cadence, or the terrain has been classified Ongoing Evolution

sections.title: Terrain classification protocol
sections.trigger: running /restack-journey start, or re-classifying terrain mid-journey because the ground has changed

sections.title: Journey state template
sections.trigger: creating docs/journey/journey-state.md at /restack-journey start, or reconstructing it mid-journey

sections.title: Assumptions register template
sections.trigger: creating docs/journey/assumptions-register.md, or appending to one whose shape you need to confirm

sections.title: Decisions log template
sections.trigger: creating docs/journey/decisions-log.md, or logging the first gate of a journey
